description: Draws the Rack background: a picture, a colour wash, a linear gradient, a radial gradient, a vignette and cases around groups of modules, each of them animated from control voltage

params.text: Turns the colour wash layer on and off
Sets how far the colour wash is brought in, 0% to 100%
Turns the linear gradient layer on and off
Sets how far the gradient's start colour is brought in, 0% to 100%
Sets where the gradient starts across the Rack window, 0% at the left edge and 100% at the right
Sets where the gradient starts down the Rack window, 0% at the top and 100% at the bottom
Sets how far the gradient's end colour is brought in, 0% to 100%
Sets where the gradient ends across the Rack window, 0% at the left edge and 100% at the right
Sets where the gradient ends down the Rack window, 0% at the top and 100% at the bottom
Turns the radial gradient layer on and off
Sets how far the radial gradient's inner colour is brought in, 0% to 100%
Sets the centre of the radial gradient across the Rack window, 0% at the left edge and 100% at the right
Sets the centre of the radial gradient down the Rack window, 0% at the top and 100% at the bottom
Sets how far the radial gradient's outer colour is brought in, 0% to 100%
Sets the radius of the radial gradient, 0% to 100% of the Rack window
Turns the box gradient, the vignette, on and off
Sets how far the vignette's inner colour is brought in, 0% to 100%
Pulls the left and right sides of the vignette in from the edges of the Rack window, 0% to 100%
Pulls the top and bottom of the vignette in from the edges of the Rack window, 0% to 100%
Sets how far the vignette's outer colour is brought in, 0% to 100%
Rounds the corners of the vignette, 0% to 100%
Sets how soft the edge of the vignette is, 0% to 100%
Turns the background picture layer on and off

inputs.text: Moves the colour wash away from the colour picked for it, a tenth of the range per volt; this one voltage is applied to hue, saturation, lightness and transparency alike
Patching a cable here switches the colour wash to modulated, but this jack's own voltage is never read; the hue jack of this row drives all four colour parts
Adds to the colour wash's own fade, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full
Moves the linear gradient's start colour away from the colour picked for it, a tenth of the range per volt; this one voltage is applied to hue, saturation, lightness and transparency alike

Adds to the gradient start's position across the Rack window, 10% per volt, and the total is held between the left and right edges
Adds to the gradient start's position down the Rack window, 10% per volt, and the total is held between the top and bottom edges

Adds to the gradient end's position down the Rack window, 10% per volt, and the total is held between the top and bottom edges

Adds to the radial gradient's inner fade, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full
Adds to the radial gradient's centre across the Rack window, 10% per volt, and the total is held between the left and right edges
Adds to the radial gradient's centre down the Rack window, 10% per volt, and the total is held between the top and bottom edges

Adds to the vignette's inner fade, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full
Adds to how far the vignette's sides are pulled in, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full
Adds to how far the vignette's top and bottom are pulled in, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full
Moves the vignette's outer colour away from the colour picked for it, a tenth of the range per volt; this one voltage is applied to hue, saturation, lightness and transparency alike
Patching a cable here switches the vignette's outer colour to modulated, but this jack's own voltage is never read; the hue jack of this row drives all four colour parts
Adds to the vignette's outer fade, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full
Adds to the rounding of the vignette's corners, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full
Adds to the softness of the vignette's edge, 10% per volt, and the total is held between none and full

notes: nothing is drawn until the background is switched on; every layer stays hidden and the blue lamp stays dark until then
a layer's own check box has to be ticked as well; only the colour wash is ticked on a new module
the picture layer shows nothing until an image file is chosen, whatever the check box says
a colour input is only read while its layer is ticked and that colour's fade is above zero
a fast, full-range signal on these inputs gives flashing results; a bipolar signal through an attenuator, with the knobs set part way, gives a gentler one
only one FancyBox works at a time, counting the mini: a second one added to the patch is drawn greyed out with no controls on it at all
the six layers are drawn one over another in this order: picture, colour wash, linear gradient, radial gradient, vignette, cases
the cases layer draws a frame and a drop shadow around each unbroken run of modules; a module standing on its own gets no case, and a gap of more than 1HP starts a new one
the ON•OFF button in the title bar switches the whole background on and off, and it is not a parameter, so no click on it reaches this help
the picture button and the hamburger beside it open the image file and the Image options dialog, which holds the fitting, grayscale, offset and scale settings
the image settings have no control on the panel, so no click on the module reaches help for them
the palette button in each layer picks that layer's colour, and the swatch beside it shows the colour as it stands; the buttons are not parameters, so no click on them reaches this help
the plug mark in the title bar folds the column of jacks away to make the module narrower; it refuses while any cable is patched
the case settings, the bezel and edge widths, the four colours and the drop shadow, are in the Skiff box options dialog on the module menu, with no control on the panel
menu: Keep effects when removed — leaves the background in place after this module is deleted from the patch; the settings are then lost when the patch is unloaded, so save a preset first
Shouting button — switches the ON•OFF lettering between capitals and mixed case
Skiff box options... — opens the dialog holding the case colours, the edge and bezel widths and the drop shadow
